scope: Public HTTPS static deployment snapshot only; not complete server source, backend, database, secrets, or private files.
reference_policy: Only explicit same-authorized-host static references and explicit sourceMappingURL links. Query URLs are rejected; URLs are deduplicated before fetching. Vite dependency paths and bounded brand image templates are resolved from the downloaded JavaScript without executing it. No guessed .git, credentials, source maps, or business API requests.
deduplication_note: An interrupted preliminary parser run generated redundant bundle copies from query-only strings. Its entire task-owned download directory was removed before this final snapshot. This final run rejects all query URLs and deduplicates canonical static URLs.
